findings.desc: Topology completeness is blocked by independently observed missing closure and invalid provenance. The official proof-or-stop acceptance_basis --storyId=B-5a88 --json result is status=verified but basisStatus=partial, with plannedPathRecords=[] and excludedPathRefs=[]; its blind spots include packages/main/templates/agents and five migration test paths (packages/main/tests/bin-alias-migration.test.mjs, brand-role-migration.test.mjs, managed-marker-migration.test.mjs, prompt-role-migration.test.mjs, release-push-approval-migration.test.mjs), so no signed exclusion accounts for those paths. acceptance_matrix reports topology state legacy_missing with no declarations or endpoints. Independently, topology_critic_receipt_check --storyId=B-5a88 rejects with AT_TOPOLOGY_CRITIC_CONTEXT_INVALID because implementation provenance lacks a business commit authored by the required implementer identity. The current implementation diff changes the topology producer to require proof-or-stop-implementer while accepting the legacy author only on read, but the current story history has no qualifying canonical or legacy implementer-authored business commit. Therefore this critic cannot truthfully certify scope, exclusions, or producer/consumer closure for RI-002.
